milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate/observe task. The player must navigate near the nether brick structure and face toward it to 'find' the nether_brick_fence. The target is set to the center of the front roofline fence row (spawn+8, spawn+4, spawn+6), which is the most visible and prominent fence location. max_distance=16 allows the player to spot it from a reasonable distance, and facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking toward the fence, confirming visual observation rather than just being nearby while facing away.

scene_description: A small nether-themed outpost building on a grass plain. The structure is a 5x5 nether brick building with four corner pillars, a flat roof, and two doorways (front and back). Nether_brick_fence blocks are placed as a decorative railing along the front and back edges of the rooftop, clearly silhouetted against the sky for easy visual identification. A cobblestone path leads from the spawn area toward the structure. Decorative elements include a magma block and lantern inside, plus passive mobs (pig, cow) for environmental variety.
task_text: Find and look at the nether brick fence. Navigate toward the dark nether-themed structure and locate the nether_brick_fence blocks on its rooftop.
design_notes: Structure at spawn+6 to spawn+10 on x/z axes, 4 blocks tall with fence on top at y+4. Front doorway faces spawn (z=6 side). Cobblestone path from ~3,0,3 to ~6,0,6 guides player toward structure. Nether_brick_fence placed as rooftop railing on front (z=6) and back (z=10) edges — 5 blocks each, 10 total. Fence is silhouetted against sky for maximum visibility. Passive mobs add environmental variety without interfering with the task.
